primary_source.title: Cover Crops for Ecological Management of U.S. Agricultural Systems: Quantifying Ecosystem Services Across Multiple Scales
primary_source.author: Lisa Eash
primary_source.verification: Dates transcribed from table and visually checked against a Poppler rendering of PDF page 206. The full PDF is a temporary source, not a redistributed repository artifact.

corroborating_sources.scope: Corroborates exact wheat sowing/harvest dates for T1/C1, T2/C1 and T1/C2. Later cycles were not complete at that paper's preparation.

corroborating_sources.locator: Methods: Experimental design; Appendix S1, Table S4
corroborating_sources.scope: Confirms the two-year rotation and points to an operation-date supplement. Generic September/July prose does not override exact dates in the author's table.

corroborating_sources.locator: Methods and source workbook Metadata/Field Data
corroborating_sources.scope: Release with C1/C2/C3 outcome columns. Metadata describes profile water near wheat sowing and yields by cycle.

retained_uncertainties: Exact soil-water and nitrate sampling days are not recorded per row in the release; calendar verification does not invent those dates.
The workbook's T2/C3 cycle-year label is inconsistent with the exact operation calendar; excluded from yield evaluation because no final harvest was observed.
Profile water is source-defined 0-90 cm total storage in mm, not verified plant-available water.
